title: Great features: not enough freedom to see if I really liked it
body: Your app has some great features. I am in the process of trying to find a HabitBull alternative after years of use. Your app had some of the features I was looking for. Unfortunately: I couldn’t move around or familiarize myself enough to justify paying to unlock integral features to the functioning of the app.
author: dkeug'slzkqkfhdj
